App.summary: Root dashboard; fetches alert rows from Supabase and applies filters.

SupabaseClient.summary: Supabase client with env-driven TABLE switch and API alert adapter mapper.

WranglerConfig.summary: Cloudflare deploy config: static assets from dist with SPA fallback, no Worker entry.

RefreshGtfs.summary: Weekly script downloading Metrolinx GTFS, filtering Barrie line, reloading Supabase tables.

RailMap.summary: Interactive Barrie Line map showing active station statuses and delay counts.

IncidentFeed.summary: Feed displaying real-time and historical GO Barrie line alerts and incidents.

TripTracker.summary: Visualizes multi-station delay progression across GTFS-resolved trips on the Barrie line.

Heatmap.summary: Commute period and calendar heatmaps aggregating historical Barrie line delays.

Filters.summary: Controls time horizon, rush hour, reason, and direction filter dropdowns for alerts.

StatsBar.summary: Summarizes delay statistics, cancellations, and on-time reliability metrics for filtered alerts.

GoApiTables.summary: Migration defining API ingestion tables, indexes, and RLS policies for Metrolinx alerts and trip updates.

IngestGoApi.summary: Polls Metrolinx ServiceUpdates/TripUpdates, filters Barrie, upserts into go_api_* tables.

IngestGoApiWorkflow.summary: Runs ingest_go_api.py every 8 minutes plus manual dispatch with Supabase/Metrolinx secrets.
